title: Genetic-to-postmortem expression direction coupling across human brain disorders
description: Aggregate-only reproducibility bundle for a multi-cohort donor-level transcriptomic analysis of the agreement between genetically anchored and postmortem expression directions. The release excludes third-party raw data and donor-level information. This work was supported by the Natural Science Foundation of Shandong Province (ZR2023MH340; principal investigator: Hui Yang).
